ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 10% high-intensity (white) to 90% low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixel clusters localized at distal tips; stochastic high-intensity speckling distributed across both lobes; one prominent high-intensity linear feature on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch; approximate interior angle of 40-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile along trailing edge; right lobe distal edge contains several deep (10+ pixel) notches; high-frequency low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) variations elsewhere.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature from the central notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete high-intensity clusters concentrated at the distal tips; scattered high-intensity circular points primarily on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal high-intensity linear scar on the left lobe; multiple faint, parallel linear marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep diagonal white scar on the left lobe; irregular traumatic notches on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
